zh: 每走一步的代价都相同，这是无权网格上的最短路问题。
从左上角做广度优先搜索：按层扩展时，每个格子第一次被访问时的步数就是它的最短距离。0 格不能进入，已访问的格子不再入队。
把格子编号为"行×列数+列"，用一个初值为 −1 的距离数组和数组实现的队列；出队时若是 9 就输出它的距离，否则检查上下左右四个邻居，可通行且未访问的距离加一后入队；队列空了还没遇到 9 就输出 −1。
en: Every move costs the same, so this is a shortest-path problem on an unweighted grid.

Run a breadth-first search from the top-left corner: when expanding level by level, the step count at which a cell is first reached is its shortest distance. Cells with 0 cannot be entered, and visited cells are never enqueued again.

Number each cell as row times width plus column, and use a distance array initialized to -1 plus an array-based queue. When you dequeue a 9, print its distance; otherwise look at the four neighbors and enqueue each passable unvisited one with distance plus one. If the queue empties without reaching 9, print -1.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Run BFS with a one-dimensional distance array and an index queue, entering only non-0 cells and marking each cell when it is first enqueued.

## Proof of Correctness

Every move costs 1, so BFS visits cells in increasing order of distance and the first distance assigned to a cell is the shortest; reaching 9 gives the shortest route. If the queue runs out, the destination is unreachable.

## Complexity

Time O(rc), space O(rc), using compact integer arrays to store the queue and the distances.
